title: Catalog
purpose: See one catalog with the forms that use it, its items and its history, and add, reorder or open its items.
summary: One catalog of orderable items: its description, the forms that use it, its items in the order clients see them, and its change history. Only the admin role can open this page.

tasks.title: Add an item
steps: Select [[Add item]], enter the [[Item name]] and, if the laboratory has one, the [[Item code]] and [[Unit]].
Save. The item goes to the end of the list.

tasks.title: Put items in the order clients see
steps: In the last column of a row, open [[Move]] and select [[Move up]] or [[Move down]].

tasks.title: Stop offering an item
steps: Select the item's name, clear [[Active]], give a reason and save.
Select [[Show inactive]] to find it again.

tasks.title: Rename or switch off the catalog
steps: Select [[Edit catalog]], change it, write the reason and save.

good_to_know: Clients see only active items. An item you switch off disappears from new tickets but stays on tickets that ordered it.
Other names are shown under an item's name on the form, so clients find it by a cap color or a common name.
A catalog that is inactive cannot be chosen by new item-list fields.
The product records the order. The laboratory fills it.

items.label: Status line
items.description: Under the title: Active or Inactive, and the number of items shown (offered, when only active items are listed).

items.label: Add item
items.description: Opens the form to add an item to this catalog.

items.label: Description
items.description: The staff note about what the catalog holds. None when empty.

items.label: Used by
items.description: The active item-list fields that use the catalog, each as the form's name (linked) and the field's label in brackets. No form uses it when there are none.

items.label: Key
items.description: The catalog's stable code. It never changes.

sections.title: Items table
paragraphs: Items are listed in the order clients see them. Select Show inactive to include items that were switched off, and Hide inactive to return. Inactive items carry an Inactive mark and cannot be ordered.

items.label: Item
items.description: The item's name. It opens the item's settings.

items.label: Code
items.description: The laboratory's item number. A dash when none.

items.label: Unit
items.description: What one counts as, for example each, box of 50 or case of 12. A dash when none.

items.label: Most per ticket
items.description: The most a client may order at once. No limit when empty.

items.label: Other names
items.description: Words clients use for the item. Shown under its name in the form. Hidden first on narrow screens.

items.label: Move
items.description: Menu with Move up and Move down, one step each. The first row has no Move up and the last no Move down. The move uses the full order, inactive items included.

items.label: No items yet
items.description: Shown when the catalog has no item. It offers Add item.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: The latest recorded changes to the catalog itself, newest first, with who made them, when and the reason. Changes to its items are in each item's history in the audit log.
